name: Buró con dos cajones y patas
adaptations: solid jequitibá and mañío in the original; drawn in T18 plywood
straight legs of two glued layers under a set-back apron, instead of splayed tapered legs
flat drawer fronts instead of fluted (routed) ones; applied wooden bar pulls not drawn
finish looks like a clear natural oil or wax; no wax-oil id, danish-oil is the closest
notes: Buró de dos cajones iguales con frentes acanalados y jaladeras de barra de madera, sobre cuatro patas abiertas. Cubierta encima de los laterales.
